exceptions.disposition: representation-only exception; excluded from strict target-state mismatch count when the current PWQE 5.1 source confirms the entry-point identity
exceptions.basis: The Python reference emits entry:<id> as a target-resolution pseudo-row. The authoritative routing_targets.json keeps entry_points separate from its 92 target definitions, and the TypeScript router represents these as direct opted-in candidates. There is no TypeScript target-state record to compare. This exception does not cover candidate eligibility, item selection, or any non-entry target.
